title: sapium pallens
intro: Sapium pallens, commonly known as the Yellow Myrtle or Yellow Stilt Tree, is a plant species native to tropical Asia and Australia. The health benefits of Sapium pallens include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sapium pallens include its ability to reduce fever, relieve cough and respiratory issues, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Sapium pallens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
